title: Home Renovation Field Worksheets
subtitle: Short working pages for scope, contractor decisions, changes and handover

pages.title: Room brief and scope boundary
pages.intro: Write what the room needs to do before choosing finishes. Separate included work from ideas you are deliberately saving for later.
checks: Describe the daily problem this work should solve
List must-haves separately from nice-to-haves
Photograph existing conditions before work
Record exclusions and open technical questions
Name who can approve a scope change

pages.title: Contractor quote comparison
pages.intro: Ask each contractor to price the same scope and note assumptions, exclusions and schedule dependencies before comparing totals.
checks: Confirm the same work description and finish level
Check disposal, delivery, protection and cleanup
Identify allowances and provisional sums
Confirm licence, insurance or permit needs locally
Review payment, cancellation and variation terms

pages.title: Change request and approval record
pages.intro: Use one line per change. Keep the reason, price and schedule impact beside the approval so the decision does not get separated from its consequences.
checks: Describe the requested or required change
Ask for cost or credit in writing
Record timing and dependency effects
Attach photographs or revised drawings
Confirm approval before proceeding where feasible

pages.title: Materials, samples and delivery log
pages.intro: Track the exact product and approved finish. Confirm quantities, batch or lot where relevant, lead time and who owns ordering and delivery checks.
checks: Photograph the approved sample in the room
Record manufacturer, product and finish
Confirm quantity and measurement owner
Check lead time before committing dates
Inspect delivery and keep batch labels
fields: Quantity, lead time and arrival date

pages.title: Practical completion and handover
pages.intro: Walk through against the agreed scope. Record unfinished work, defects and the person and date for each follow-up.
checks: Test installed fixtures, doors, drawers and lights
Compare finishes with the approved specification
Photograph and describe each open item
Collect warranties, manuals and final invoices
Record maintenance advice and outstanding dates
